task: Create an AWS Lambda function configuration that specifies a 256MB memory allocation, 30-second timeout, and environment variables for database connection strings
solution_criteria: Must include MemorySize set to 256, Timeout set to 30, Environment object with Variables containing at least one database connection string, and proper JSON structure

task: Write a Python function that extracts the AWS account ID and region from an S3 ARN string
solution_criteria: Function must parse S3 ARN format (arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/key), extract account ID if present, identify region, return both values as a tuple or dictionary, and handle invalid ARN formats gracefully

task: Create a regex pattern that validates AWS IAM role names according to AWS naming conventions
solution_criteria: Pattern must allow alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores, enforce minimum 1 and maximum 64 character length, and reject names starting with invalid characters per AWS IAM specifications
